# MCP reference

Every tool, prompt and resource the server registers, with the parameters and
descriptions clients receive. How to use them together: [MCP tools](../mcp-tools.md).

## Contract

Clients read the same text from the resource `relaybay://contract`.

Contract version 2.

Within a contract version a release never removes a tool, a parameter, a resource or a prompt (or a prompt argument), never narrows what a parameter accepts (its type, enum or range), never adds a required parameter to an existing tool and never turns a read-only tool into a writing one; new behaviour comes as new optional parameters or new tools, and `task_update(fields=...)` and `backlog_patch` reach fields a cached schema lacks. A removal is announced first: the tool's description and every result of the deprecated tool or parameter carry a `Deprecated: …` line, for at least one minor version and 30 days. The release that removes it raises the contract version.

Deprecations:

| Item | Parameter | Since | Removed not before | Use instead |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environments_get` | — | 0.15 | 2026-12-19 | environments and access were removed in 0.15; environments are kept in the project's own notes. |
| `environment_propose` | — | 0.15 | 2026-12-19 | environments and access were removed in 0.15; environments are kept in the project's own notes. |
| `relaybay://project/{slug}/environments` | — | 0.15 | 2026-12-19 | environments and access were removed in 0.15; environments are kept in the project's own notes. |
| `task_set_stage` | — | 0.17 | 2027-01-15 | task_update(task, stage=..., stage_note=..., next_step=..., waiting_on=...) |
| `task_patch` | — | 0.17 | 2027-01-15 | task_update(task, fields={...}) |

### `project_list`

List all projects with task counts per stage. Call it to find a project's slug.

No parameters.

### `project_upsert`

Create a project, or rename it / set its repositories / archive it. Call it once before creating the first task of a project that is not on the board yet (see project_list).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string | yes | Project slug such as 'acme-shop'. |
| `name` | string or null | no | Display name. |
| `repo_path` | string or null | no | Path to the repository: the path of the first one in `repos`. |
| `description` | string or null | no | One-line description. |
| `archived` | boolean or null | no | Coordinator sessions only. true sends the project to the archive: it leaves the project list, the board's sidebar, the Inbox and the digests, and nothing is deleted; false brings it back. |
| `repos` | list of object or null | no | The project's repositories, the whole list in order: [{"name": "web", "path": "/code/acme/web", "kind": "web"}]. kind is one of app, web, api, lib, other (optional); without a name the path's last folder names it. Matched by name, so tasks keep their links to a repository that stays; [] removes them all. The path is stored as written. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `project_delete`

Delete an archived project for good, for coordinator sessions only: its tasks with their reports, comments, plans and attachments, its documents (the rows only; files on disk stay), backlog, decisions, notes and areas. An export of everything deleted is written first to `deleted/` in the server's data folder. A project not in the archive is refused; archive it first with project_upsert(archived=true).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | string | yes | Project slug such as 'acme-shop'. |
| `confirm` | string | yes | The project's slug once more: the deletion cannot be undone. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `project_snapshot`

Compact markdown snapshot of a project: open tasks by stage with waiting-on, next step, branch, the start of the description and progress, last report, the merge order of the cards on test (two or more), plus recent decisions. Call it at the start of a session to see the state of the project before you pick or create a task.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project slug such as 'acme-shop'. |
| `include_done` | boolean | no | Also list done tasks. Default: `False`. |

### `project_pulse_set`

Write the project's pulse note: a short hand-written summary, shown with its date under the pulse line relaybay derives from the cards (in the digests and on the board). Optional; it is never marked stale.

| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `task_context`

One task, for the session working on it: fields and progress, plan with the current step, its decisions and the project decisions related to it, linked document sections, rules, unread owner comments (ids; text only of those already delivered to you), relevant notes, the open backlog items of its subject and what changed since your last read. It delivers no comment.

| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `task_list`

List tasks, filtered by project, stage, who they wait on, the bound session or the area. Done tasks are left out unless a stage or include_done is given.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string or null | no | Project slug filter. |
| `stage` | string or null | no | Stage filter. |
| `waiting_on` | string or null | no | Exact 'waiting on' value. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Bound session: desktop session id or name. |
| `include_done` | boolean | no | Include done tasks. Default: `False`. |
| `area` | string or null | no | Area name filter (case does not matter). |

### `task_get`

Full task: fields, description, progress, current version, the linked document sections, the latest reports and decisions, and the names of the editable fields (for task_update(fields=...)). Call it before task_update to get the version for expected_version.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |
| `reports` | integer | no | How many reports. Default: `5`. |

### `task_create`

Create a task when you start work that is not on the board yet. Give it a short `description` (what to do and why). Returns its key (e.g. 'acme-shop-12'); use the key in later calls. If `session` is given, the task is bound to that session unless `bind` is false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project slug such as 'acme-shop'. |
| `title` | string | yes | Short task title. |
| `stage` | string or null | no | Initial stage; default plan. |
| `waiting_on` | string or null | no | Only who acts next: a name or role, no text after it; what happens goes to next_step. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `next_step` | string or null | no | The next concrete step. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `branch` | string or null | no | Git branch. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `doc_path` | string or null | no | The task's document: a relaybay://doc link, or a local .md file (an absolute path), which becomes the file document task-<key> when no document reads it yet. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `description` | string or null | no | What to do and why, 1-5 sentences of markdown. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `progress` | string or null | no | Markdown summary of everything done so far on the task (not just the last step). Rewrite it as the work goes on and keep it current with every report. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `tracker_ref` | string or null | no | Issue key or number in the external tracker, e.g. 'ENG-12'. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `tracker_name` | string or null | no | Name of the external tracker, e.g. 'Linear'. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `tracker_url` | string or null | no | Link to the issue (http:// or https:// only). '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `tracker_logged` | boolean | no | True once the work log is entered in the external tracker. New work clears it again (a report, a progress change, a move back from live or done). A new tracker_ref starts as not logged unless tracker_logged is passed in the same write. Done tasks without it stay on the board marked 'not logged'. Default: `False`. |
| `area` | string or null | no | What part of the project the task belongs to, by name, e.g. 'web shop' (project_snapshot lists the project's areas; case does not matter). A new name is added to the project's areas and the answer says so. '-' or '' leaves it empty. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |
| `bind` | boolean | no | false: you create the card for someone else; it is not bound to your session (a session started for it binds itself, or the launch does). Default: `True`. |
| `inspect_only` | boolean | no | true for a card that only reads (an analysis, a repro, a question answered by reading): it needs no accepted plan before dev and may go straight to done. A report on it that says changed, committed or pushed warns. Default: `False`. |
| `sections` | list of string or null | no | Sections of the project's documents to link to the card, each 'doc#anchor' (as task_doc_link links one). Optional. |

### `task_doc_link`

Link a section of a project document to the card (remove=true unlinks it). The anchor is checked against the document's current outline. task_context lists the linked sections first, and takes the card's subject (for its backlog items and related decisions) from them; a section that disappears later shows as broken.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |
| `doc` | string | yes | Document name of the task's project, e.g. 'spec'. |
| `section` | string | yes | The section: its heading anchor or explicit anchor, as doc_outline lists them, e.g. 'payouts'. |
| `remove` | boolean | no | true: unlink the section. Default: `False`. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `task_update`

Change task fields and move its stage in one write: the stage, waiting on, next step, branch, description, progress, the area, the tracker issue and its work-log mark, deploy notes, a cancel reason, the repositories it touches, its pull requests, the cards blocking it; `fields` for anything else. Omitted fields stay as they are; '-' or an empty string clears a field. Keep `progress` current with every report. Also update next_step (what happens next) and waiting_on (who acts next) whenever the stage changes or you report.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |
| `title` | string or null | no | New title. |
| `waiting_on` | string or null | no | Only who acts next: a name or role, no text after it; what happens goes to next_step. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `next_step` | string or null | no | The next concrete step. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `branch` | string or null | no | Git branch. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `doc_path` | string or null | no | The task's document: a relaybay://doc link, or a local .md file (an absolute path), which becomes the file document task-<key> when no document reads it yet. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `stage_note` | string or null | no | Note next to the stage. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `description` | string or null | no | What to do and why, 1-5 sentences of markdown. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `progress` | string or null | no | Markdown summary of everything done so far on the task (not just the last step). Rewrite it as the work goes on and keep it current with every report. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `tracker_ref` | string or null | no | Issue key or number in the external tracker, e.g. 'ENG-12'. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `tracker_name` | string or null | no | Name of the external tracker, e.g. 'Linear'. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `tracker_url` | string or null | no | Link to the issue (http:// or https:// only). '-' or '' clears it. |
| `tracker_logged` | boolean or null | no | True once the work log is entered in the external tracker. New work clears it again (a report, a progress change, a move back from live or done). A new tracker_ref starts as not logged unless tracker_logged is passed in the same write. Done tasks without it stay on the board marked 'not logged'. |
| `size` | string or null | no | Task size: S, M or L. S tasks may go without an accepted plan; a task of unknown size needs one. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `area` | string or null | no | What part of the project the task belongs to, by name, e.g. 'web shop' (project_snapshot lists the project's areas; case does not matter). A new name is added to the project's areas and the answer says so. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `repos` | list of string or null | no | Repositories of the task's project the task touches, by name, added to its links; '-name' removes one. An unknown name fails with the project's names. A session bound to the task links the repository it works in by itself. 'name <absolute path>' also sets the folder (worktree) the task works in there. |
| `prs` | list of string or null | no | Pull request links (http:// or https://) added to the task, optionally after a repository name: 'web https://host/acme/web/pull/12'; '-url' removes one. Without a name, a link whose path names a project repository is tied to it (and links it). |
| `blocked_by` | list of string or null | no | Cards this task waits for, by key, of any project on the board: 'acme-shop-12'; '-key' removes one. A blocker blocks while it is in plan, dev, review or test, and no longer at live or done. An unknown key, the task itself and a cycle are refused. |
| `inspect_only` | boolean or null | no | true for a card that only reads (an analysis, a repro, a question answered by reading): it needs no accepted plan before dev and may go straight to done. A report on it that says changed, committed or pushed warns. |
| `stage` | string or null | no | Move the task: plan, dev, review, test, live or done (a move that misses a working rule adds a 'Warning (rules)' line). |
| `deploy_notes` | string or null | no | What a deploy of this card needs: migration, feature flag, script, rollback. Writing it clears deploy_done unless deploy_done is passed in the same write. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `deploy_done` | boolean or null | no | True once the steps in deploy_notes have been carried out. |
| `cancelled` | string or null | no | Why the card was given up on; setting it stamps the time. The card stays in its stage (move it to done yourself). '-' clears it and its time. |
| `fields` | object or null | no | Any other task field as one JSON object, e.g. {'priority': 2} (relaybay://schema/task lists them); for a field this tool has no parameter for yet. A field given both here and as a parameter must agree. |
| `expected_version` | integer or null | no | Fail instead of overwriting if the task changed since you read it. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `task_patch`

Change any task fields given as one JSON object, with the same rules as task_update and task_set_stage (a `stage` value moves the task). Use it for a field your client's task_update does not offer yet: its parameter list may be older than the server. Call task_get or read relaybay://schema/task for the allowed fields. `session_surface` ("desktop" or "terminal", with your hook_session) is not a task field: it tells relaybay where you run, when your session start asks for it. Deprecated: task_patch is deprecated since 0.17 and may be removed in a later minor version, not before 2027-01-15; use task_update(task, fields={...}) instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |
| `fields` | object | yes | Task fields to change as one JSON object, e.g. {"branch": "x"}. Call task_get or read relaybay://schema/task for the allowed fields; '-', '' or null clears an optional text field. |
| `expected_version` | integer or null | no | Fail instead of overwriting if the task changed since you read it. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `task_set_stage`

Move a task to another stage (plan, dev, review, test, live, done) when its work moves on, e.g. to dev when you start coding, to review when the owner should accept it step by step (fill the checklist with review_steps_set first), to test when it is on the test environment, to done when finished. Any transition is allowed; a move that misses a working rule (see rules_get) adds a 'Warning (rules)' line. Also update next_step (what happens next) and waiting_on (who acts next) whenever the stage changes or you report. Deprecated: task_set_stage is deprecated since 0.17 and may be removed in a later minor version, not before 2027-01-15; use task_update(task, stage=..., stage_note=..., next_step=..., waiting_on=...) instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |
| `stage` | string | yes | One of: plan, dev, review, test, live, done. |
| `note` | string or null | no | Short note next to the stage, e.g. 'PR open'. |
| `next_step` | string or null | no | What happens next, one line; saved in the same write. A next step set before the last stage change shows as stale. Omit to keep it; '-' or '' clears it. |

| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `task_archive`

Send a done or live task to the archive now, for coordinator sessions only: it leaves the board's columns (the board's "show archive" and search still find it). A live task is closed and archived in one step, and task_unarchive returns it to live. Any later stage change takes it out of the archive. Nothing is deleted now; after the server's `archive_purge_days` (30 by default) in the archive relaybay deletes it, with an export written first.

|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |

| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `task_unarchive`

Bring a task back from the archive, for coordinator sessions only: a done one shows in the done column again (the automatic done window starts again from now), one archived from live goes back to live.

Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `task_bind_session`

Mark that this session works on the task now; the board shows it with a link that opens the Claude desktop app session. Call it when you pick up an existing task. Pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it. If you don't know your local_ id, don't rebind — the coordinator binds you; pass your session name only as `session` on writes. A plain name never replaces a desktop session bound to the task: it is recorded as that session's alias. Binding a session ends the previous session's binding; the history is kept. It never links a hook session (the caller may bind someone else): your own `hook_session` goes on your other writes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |
| `session` | string | yes | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Not linked here: pass your hook_session on your own writes instead. |
| `caller` | string or null | no | You, when `session` is someone else. Optional. |

### `task_unbind_session`

Remove the bound session from a task, e.g. when a session stops working on it without a successor. The binding history is kept. To hand the task to another session, call task_bind_session instead.

|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |
| `session` | string or null | no | The session you expect to be bound (desktop session id or name); if another session is bound, nothing changes and an error says who. Optional. |
| `caller` | string or null | no | You, when `session` is someone else. Optional. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `report_add`

Add a report to a task. Call it at the end of every stage with your final report: what changed, how it was checked, what is left. Pass `progress` too, so the task's summary of what is done stays current with every report. Also update next_step (what happens next) and waiting_on (who acts next) whenever the stage changes or you report. `stage` ends the stage in the same call; findings and questions outside the task go in `findings` and `questions`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | Task key such as 'acme-shop-12', or its numeric id. |
| `body` | string | yes | Markdown report. Its first line is the summary; a first line 'state · size · gist' (e.g. 'verified · M · login fixed') also sets state (inspected, changed, verified, committed, pushed, blocked) and size (S, M, L). Mark each claim you checked with 'verified: <where>' (e.g. 'verified: pytest on Windows'); an M or L report without any mark gets a rules warning. |
| `progress` | string or null | no | Markdown summary of everything done so far on the task (not just the last step). Rewrite it as the work goes on and keep it current with every report. Saved together with the report; omit to keep it; '-' or '' clears it. |
| `next_step` | string or null | no | What happens next, one line; saved in the same write. A next step set before the last stage change shows as stale. Omit to keep it; '-' or '' clears it. |
| `waiting_on` | string or null | no | Only who acts next: a name or role, no text after it; what happens goes to next_step. Saved in the same write. Omit to keep it; '-' or '' clears it. |
| `stage` | string or null | no | Move the task to this stage in the same write, after the report, so a rule asking for a report since the last stage change is met; the move's rule warnings follow (strict rules refuse the report too). Omit: the answer names what the usual next move needs. |
| `findings` | list of object or null | no | Findings outside this task, for the coordinator to triage (none becomes a backlog item by itself), at most 10: [{"title": "Cart total rounds down", "body": "...", "location": "web/cart.py:41", "kind": "bug", "area": "checkout"}]. title is required (up to 200 characters); kind is one of bug, idea, question, debt. |
| `questions` | list of object or null | no | Questions for the coordinator, at most 10: [{"text": "Keep the old route?", "default": "keep it until the next release"}]. Both are required: default is what happens if nobody answers. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

| `summary` | string | yes | What goes where: the commits, the files, the CI state. Never a password or token. |
| `rollback` | string or null | no | The command that undoes it: required for a deploy. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |

### `doc_update`

Write a new version of a project document (base_version 0 creates it). If it changed since you read it, nothing is saved and the current text comes back to merge. With lines + expected only those lines change, as long as they still read as expected. A task's document is `task-<ref>`; point the task at it with task_update(doc_path= 'relaybay://doc/<project>/task-<ref>'). A document linked with source_url may have body '-' (no text of its own). A file document (source_path) whose writes through relaybay are on is written in its file: only the replaced lines change, its line endings stay; a change made to the file outside relaybay is a new version first. With writes off it is refused: edit the file. With delete the document is deleted (see delete). A write ends with a warning that lists the links leading nowhere: relaybay://doc links to a missing document or section and in-document (#anchor) links.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project slug such as 'acme-shop'. |
| `doc` | string | yes | Document name: lowercase letters, digits, dashes. |
| `body` | string | yes | Markdown: the whole document, or with `section` that section (starting with its heading to rename it, or just the text under it). |
| `reason` | string | yes | What changed and why, one line. |
| `base_version` | integer | yes | The version you read (doc_get shows it); 0 creates the document. |
| `section` | string or null | no | Replace only this section (its anchor). |
| `title` | string or null | no | Title; default: the first '# ' heading. |
| `kind` | string or null | no | spec, status, task, brief, runbook, adr, retro or your own (default doc). |
| `source_url` | string or null | no | http(s) link when the document lives in a repository: the board links there and later writes need force; '-' unlinks. |
| `force` | boolean | no | Write a document that lives in a repository anyway. Default: `False`. |
| `source_path` | string or null | no | Absolute path of a file on this machine: with base_version 0 and body '-' it becomes a file document that relaybay indexes on demand. |
| `lines` | string or null | no | Replace only these lines 'a-b' (with expected); body '-' removes. |
| `expected` | string or null | no | The current text of `lines` as you read it; else a conflict. |
| `file_writes` | string or null | no | Coordinators only: turn writes through relaybay into a file document's file on or off (default off); with body '-' that is all it does. |
| `delete` | boolean | no | Delete the document: base_version must be the current version, body is ignored (pass '-'), reason says why. An export is written first; a file document's file stays on disk. spec and status documents: the owner or a coordinator only (spec-<task key> also the session bound to that task). Default: `False`. |
| `from_path` | string or null | no | Absolute path of a local text or markdown file to import once as the whole body (body '-'): a new document (base_version 0) or a whole write of a database document. The document keeps no link to the file. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `backlog_add`

Put a finding outside your task (a bug, a missing feature, a question for later) on the project's backlog instead of a comment or a report. It starts as new; the owner decides on the board ("To plan" creates the task). It is always added; open items with a similar title are named so that a duplicate can be closed.

| `kind` | string or null | no | What it is: bug, idea, question, debt. Optional. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `location` | string or null | no | Where in the code: 'repo:path:line', 'path:line' or a link, up to 300 characters. Optional. '-' or '' clears it. |
| `from_report` | integer or null | no | Triage a finding a report carries (report_add findings): the report id; pass `finding` with it. The finding fills title, body, location, kind and area unless given, its task becomes the item's task, and the digests stop listing it. |
| `finding` | integer or null | no | With from_report: the finding's number, from 1. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `rules_get`

The working rules: report format (first line, states, sizes), what a stage move needs (e.g. a report before test, progress before done), the description template and guidance, with the version and the rules hash. Call it at the start of a session, or when the version in project_snapshot changed or a response says the rules were updated.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string or null | no | Project slug for its merged rules; omit for the global rules. |

### `rules_update`

Change the working rules directly: a new version of the scope. Only for coordinator sessions named in the server's config; everyone else gets an error and uses rules_propose. An invalid patch is refused with the reason.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string | yes | 'global' or a project slug. |
| `patch` | object | yes | Merged on top of the scope's current version: objects key by key, other values (lists included) replace, null removes a key (a project then follows the global rules, the global rules the built-in default). Keys: report_format ({first_line, states, sizes}), stage_requirements ({stage: [requirement]}; [] drops a stage's requirements), description_template, guidance. The result must be valid rules (rules_get shows the current ones). |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why the rules change; kept in the history. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `rules_propose`

Propose a change to the working rules. Nothing changes until the owner accepts it on the board (Inbox, Settings → Rules); it is checked again against the current version then. A rejected proposal stays in the history.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string | yes | 'global' or a project slug. |
| `patch` | object | yes | Merged on top of the scope's current version: objects key by key, other values (lists included) replace, null removes a key (a project then follows the global rules, the global rules the built-in default). Keys: report_format ({first_line, states, sizes}), stage_requirements ({stage: [requirement]}; [] drops a stage's requirements), description_template, guidance. The result must be valid rules (rules_get shows the current ones). |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why the change is needed, for the owner. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |

| `change` | object | yes | Ignored. |

| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

### `policy_get`

The effective policy (levels per environment kind and capability, guard mode and rules, secret rules, test secrets) with, for every value, the layer that set it: preset, config, global file, project, environment. Read it to know why the guard or a secret check answered as it did.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string or null | no | Project slug; omit for the global policy. |
| `environment` | string or null | no | Environment name in the project, for its own policy. |

### `policy_propose`

Propose a change to the policy. Nothing changes until the owner accepts it on the board (Settings → Policy); it shows in the owner's Inbox.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string | yes | 'global', a project slug, or '<project>/<environment>'. |
| `patch` | object | yes | Merged into that layer's JSON: objects key by key, other values (lists included) replace, null removes a key. Keys: levels ({kind: {default\|capability: level}}), guard ({mode, disable, patterns}), secrets ({disable, allow, test_secrets, expose_test_secrets_to_agents}). The result must validate against the policy schema (policy_get shows the current values). |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why the change is needed, for the owner. |
| `session` | string or null | no | Who is calling: pass your own desktop session id (local_…) if you know it, otherwise a human-readable session name. Optional. |
| `session_title` | string or null | no | Display name of your session (its title), used with a desktop session id. |
| `hook_session` | string or null | no | Your own Claude Code hook session id, if the session start told you one ('Your relaybay hook session: …'); never another session's. Links the board's live status and owner comments to your session. An id another live session linked first is not moved (the response says so). Optional. |

## Resources

| URI | Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `relaybay://attachments/{attachment_id}/annotated` | annotated-screenshot | image/png | The flattened PNG of a screenshot with the owner's markup (same as attachment_get with annotated=true). |
| `relaybay://contract` | contract | text/markdown | The MCP contract: its version, the compatibility rule and the deprecations. |
| `relaybay://doc/{project}/{doc}` | project-document | text/markdown | A project document's current markdown (same as doc_get). |
| `relaybay://project/{slug}` | project-snapshot | text/markdown | Markdown snapshot of a project (same as project_snapshot). |
| `relaybay://project/{slug}/environments` | project-environments | text/markdown | Removed in 0.15 with the environments. Deprecated: environments and access were removed in 0.15; environments are kept in the project's own notes. |
| `relaybay://rules` | rules | text/markdown | The global working rules (same as rules_get without a project). |
| `relaybay://rules/{project}` | project-rules | text/markdown | A project's working rules: global rules merged with the project override. |
| `relaybay://schema/task` | task-schema | text/markdown | Editable task fields for task_update(fields=...): name, type, description, clearing. |

## Prompts

| Prompt | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `start_task` | `project`, `task`? | The project's current working rules and a checklist for starting a task. |
| `finish_stage` | `project`, `task`? | The project's current working rules and a checklist for ending a stage. |
